mapper.select: SELECT b.*, u1.user_name AS owner_name, u2.user_name AS creater_name, a.asset_name FROM bill b LEFT JOIN user u1 ON b.owner_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON b.creater_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN asset a ON b.asset_id = a.id WHERE b.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND b.bill_status IN (1, 2, 3) ORDER BY b.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN bill_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 1 END) AS unpaidCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN GREATEST(bill_total - COALESCE(bill_paid, 0), 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaidAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN bill_status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS overdueCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN bill_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS partiallyPaidCount FROM bill WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
